installCommand: cd ../.. && curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash -s bun-v1.4.0 && ~/.bun/bin/bun install --frozen-lockfile
buildCommand: cd ../.. && PATH=$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH bunx turbo run build --filter=server && cd apps/server && mkdir -p .vercel/output/functions/index.func .vercel/output/static && ~/.bun/bin/bun build vercel/entry.ts --target=bun --outfile=.vercel/output/functions/index.func/index.js && cp vercel/vc-config.json .vercel/output/functions/index.func/.vc-config.json && cp vercel/output-config.json .vercel/output/config.json
